bigIdea: Every grant dollar rebuilt trail this season, under budget, so renewing it puts 60 miles in reach.

beats.name: Problem
beats.claim: Spring storms closed 40 miles of trail.

beats.name: Solution
beats.claim: Volunteers rebuilt 52 miles, more than the goal.

beats.name: Cost
beats.claim: The season came in $6,600 under budget.

beats.name: Ask
beats.claim: Renew the grant at $184,000 so crews reach 60 miles in 2027.
